=== Overview ===
Originally, it was a Tenjin shrine and had no connection to Watatsumi no Miko Shrine. It is said to have begun on July 25 of the 5th year of {{ill|Jōwa (Muromachi period)|Q1146143|qid=Q1146143}} ({{ill|1349|Q6090|qid=Q6090}}), when a Tenmangū was invited (kanjō) from {{ill|Chikuzen Province|Q1047664|qid=Q1047664}} {{ill|Dazaifu (government)|Q144845|qid=Q144845}}.<ref>Hirayama Tsunefusa, ‘[https://dl.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/956888 Tsushima Kiji]’ (Tsushima Kiji Publication Society, 1917)</ref>

In the early {{ill|Meiji era|Q3125096|qid=Q3125096}} period, it was renamed Watatsumi no Miko Shrine. This change was due to {{ill|Kaijin Shrine|Q11559099|qid=Q11559099}} adopting the name {{ill|Watazumi Shrine|Q18457651|qid=Q18457651}}.
